Résumé
Hakim Ghazzai (SM'20) is currently a Senior Research Scientist with
KAUST, Saudi Arabia. He received the Ph.D. degree in electrical
engineering from KAUST, Saudi Arabia, in 2015, and the Diplome
d'Ingenieur (Hons.) in telecommunication engineering and the
master's degree in high-rate transmission systems from the Ecole
Superieure des Communications de Tunis (SUP'COM), Tunis,
Tunisia, in 2010 and 2011, respectively. He held several research
scholar positions, including the Qatar Mobility Innovations Center
(QMIC), Doha, Qatar, Karlstad University, Sweden, and Stevens
Institute of Technology, Hoboken, New Jersey, USA. He has been
on the Editorial Board of the IEEE Communications Letters and
the IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society. Since
2020, he joined the Board of IoT and Sensor Networks (speciality
section of Frontiers in Communications and Networks) as associate
editor. He is a recipient of appreciation for being an exemplary
reviewer for IEEE Wireless Communications Letters in 2016 and
IEEE Communications Letters in 2017. He is the author and co-
author of more than 200 publications. His general research interests
include artificial intelligence-enabled applications, the Internet of
Things, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), mobile and wireless
networks, and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs).
